|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. May ‘fly’ (landspeed = 3). Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Your cards with “Bounty” in title are immune to Aim High. |errata_history=Versions of [[Boba Fett (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Boba Fett (V) (Virtual Set 6)]]): the Committee's interim rules supplement “Star Wars CCG Changes to Virtual Set #6” (“Updated 31 Dec 2003”; PDF dated 31 December 2003; [https://web.archive.org/web/20040615005231/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/v6changes.pdf v6changes.pdf on swccgpc.com], Internet Archive capture of 15 June 2004), Section 2. Updated Dark Side Texts, lists the card with only this line: “This virtual card must be used with the Cloud City set persona.” It gives no game text, stats or lore; the supplement is “an official rules document” giving “interim updated card text” and says the texts “are not final and may differ from the texts provided in the final version of Virtual Set #6”. Stats and lore on this page are those of the January 2004 slip. This is the earliest surviving publication of the card: the first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. Image: the card's entry cut from the supplement ([[:File:OVS6-29-Boba_Fett-interim-text-2003-12-31.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Boba Fett (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata)]]): the “Final Revised Virtual Set 6” sheet “Virtual Set #6” (Players Committee; announced and tournament-legal 12 January 2004; PDF dated 12 January 2004), page 2, slip 29 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 19 June 2004; the Committee still hosts the same file as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards6.pdf VirtualCards6.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), announced on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040415220046/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news page]: “P 3. Once during your control phase, may ▲ any card with 'Bounty' in title. Your cards with 'Bounty' in the title are immune to Aim High. May “fly” (landspeed = 3). Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Immune to attrition < 4.” The first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. Stats line: “POWER 4 ABILITY 3 ARMOR 5”. Deploy 4, forfeit 7. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “6•29” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The updated sheet of 12 October 2004 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf Virtual Set 6.pdf], Internet Archive 6 April 2005; PDF dated 12 October 2004) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS6-29-Boba_Fett-original-slip-2004-10-12.png]]). '''What changed''' (from the 31 December 2003 interim text): the slip gives the card's full game text, stats and lore (“P 3. Once during your control phase, may ▲ any card with 'Bounty' in title. …”); the supplement gave no game text, only the persona note.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 29), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. May ‘fly’ (landspeed = 3). Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Your cards with “Bounty” in title are immune to Aim High. During your control phase, may take a card with “Bounty” in title into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
